guide.summary: 都 (all, both) and 也 (also, too) are adverbs, so they sit after the subject and before the verb, never at the start or end of the sentence the way English 'too' and 'all of' do. 都 looks back: it totals something already said to its left. Get the slot right, put 也 before 都, and put both before 不/没, and most of this topic is solved.

subs.label: 都 after what it totals
subs.focus: Place 都 after the plural or listed subject (or time phrase) it totals and before the verb, adjective or modal. Classic errors: English order 都我们去, 都 after the verb (我们去都). With a 在 / 跟 phrase 都 normally comes first, but 在 + place + 都 is also natural: give both alts, never mark it wrong.

subs.label: Fronting the object for 都
subs.focus: When 'all/both' refers to the object, the object must move in front of 都 (这些书我都看了). Force the choice against English order 我都看了这些书, where a singular subject leaves 都 nothing to total. Best as order/rewrite; 我这些书都看了 is a valid alt.

subs.label: 也 after the subject
subs.focus: Put 也 after the subject and before the verb, adjective, modal, 很 or coverb phrase. Classic errors: 也 at the end like 'too' (我喜欢也), at the start like 'Also,' (也我喜欢), after the verb or modal, and bare 我也 for 'me too' (needs 我也是). Time words may precede or follow the subject, always before 也.

subs.label: 也 before 都
subs.focus: When both adverbs appear, the order is fixed: 也都. The item must make the learner choose 也都 over 都也, usually with a plural subject and a context like 'they all ... too'. Order items should keep 也 and 都 as separate tiles.

subs.label: 也不, 都不 and 不都
subs.focus: Two decisions. First, 也 and 都 go before 不/没 (我也不去, 他们都没来), not after as in 我不也去. Second, 都不/都没 means 'none', 不都 means 'not all'; the English cue must make clear which is meant ('none of them' vs 'not all of them') so only one order fits. Classic error: using 都不 for 'not all', or 不都 for 'none'.

subs.label: 每 ... 都
subs.focus: A 每 phrase (每天, 每个人, 每次) is followed by 都 before the verb. Make the learner supply 都 or place it after the 每 phrase and before the verb. Classic errors: omitting 都 because 'every' needs no partner, or 都每天. Avoid 每人一本 type sentences, where 都 is optional.

subs.label: 什么 / 谁 / 哪儿 ... 都
subs.focus: Question word + 都 = 'every-/any-' (谁都知道); with a negative, 'no-/not any' (什么都不吃). The question word, even as object, precedes 都/也. Classic errors: 我不吃什么 for 'I eat nothing', omitting 都, 也 in an affirmative. In negatives 都 and 也 are both right: never set them against each other.

subs.label: 一点儿也不, 一 + measure + 也没
subs.focus: 'Not at all' / 'not even one': 一点儿 or 一 + measure (+ noun), then 也/都, then 不/没. Test the fixed order and the required negative. Classic errors: 不一点儿累, 一点儿不也累, dropping 也/都, no negative. 也 and 都 are interchangeable here: never offer both as competing options.

subs.label: 都 ... 了 for 'already'
subs.focus: 都 + time, age, amount or state + 了 = 'already (so late/old/much)'. Make the learner pick 都 over 才 or 也, or keep the final 了; a second clause must show the speaker finds it late or a lot. Classic errors: omitting 了, choosing 才 ('only'), reading 都 as 'all'.

rules.rule: 都 goes after the people or things it totals and directly before the predicate. It never goes before the subject and never after the verb.

examples.py: wǒ men dōu qù
examples.en: We are all going.

examples.py: bà ba mā ma dōu hěn máng
examples.en: Mum and Dad are both very busy.

examples.py: tā men dōu shì xué sheng
examples.en: They are all students.

rules.note: Chinese has no separate word for 'both': two things also take 都. 都 can also total a time or place phrase to its left: 这几天都很冷.

rules.rule: If the sentence has a modal verb or a 在 / 跟 / 给 phrase before the verb, 都 normally comes before all of it.
rules.pattern: Plural subject + 都 + modal / coverb phrase + Verb

examples.py: wǒ men dōu zài xué xiào chī wǔ fàn
examples.en: We all eat lunch at school.

examples.py: hái zi men dōu xiǎng qù gōng yuán
examples.en: The children all want to go to the park.

examples.py: zhè jǐ tiān dōu hěn lěng
examples.en: It has been cold all these past few days.

rules.note: Before a modal verb this is fixed (我们都想去). After a 在 + place phrase 都 is also natural (他们在北京都工作过), so 都 first is the default, not the only correct order.

rules.rule: 都 only totals what stands to its left. To say 'all of' or 'both of' about the object, move the object in front of 都.

examples.py: zhè xiē shū wǒ dōu kàn le
examples.en: I have read all of these books.

examples.py: zhè liǎng bù diàn yǐng wǒ dōu xǐ huan
examples.en: I like both of these films.

examples.py: zuò yè wǒ dōu zuò wán le
examples.en: I have finished all the homework.

rules.note: The object can also sit between the subject and 都: 我这些书都看了. With a plural subject and the object left after the verb, 都 totals the subject: 我们都看了这本书 means 'all of us read this book'.

rules.rule: 也 goes after the subject and before the whole predicate, including 很, modal verbs and 在 / 跟 phrases. It cannot start or end the sentence.

examples.py: wǒ yě shì xué sheng
examples.en: I am a student too.

examples.py: tā yě xǐ huan hē chá
examples.en: He likes drinking tea too.

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān yě qù
examples.en: I am going tomorrow too.

examples.py: wǒ yě xiǎng xué hàn yǔ
examples.en: I want to learn Chinese too.

rules.note: A time word may come before the subject (明天我也去) but 也 still follows the subject. 也 may also follow a 在 + place phrase (我在家也喝茶). For 'Also, ...' opening a sentence, Chinese uses 还有 or 另外, not 也. The short answer 'Me too' needs a verb: 我也是, 我也去.

rules.rule: When 也 and 都 are both needed, 也 comes first. 都也 is not possible.
rules.pattern: Plural subject + 也 + 都 + Verb / Adjective

examples.py: wǒ men yě dōu qù
examples.en: We are all going too.

examples.py: tā men yě dōu shì lǎo shī
examples.en: They are all teachers too.

examples.py: zhè xiē cài wǒ yě dōu chī guo
examples.en: I have tried all of these dishes too.

rules.rule: 也 and 都 come before 不 and 没. 都不 / 都没 means none.
rules.pattern: Subject + 也 / 都 + 不 / 没 + Verb

examples.py: wǒ yě bù zhī dào
examples.en: I don't know either.

examples.py: tā men dōu méi lái
examples.en: None of them came.

examples.py: wǒ men dōu bù shì xué sheng
examples.en: None of us are students.

examples.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù qù
examples.en: None of us are going either.

rules.note: English 'either' in a negative sentence is still 也. The order 不也 exists only in rhetorical questions such as 你不也去了吗?, which this topic does not drill.

rules.rule: 不 before 都 negates the 'all': 不都 means not all, only some.

examples.py: wǒ men bù dōu shì xué sheng
examples.en: Not all of us are students.

examples.py: zhè xiē zì wǒ bù dōu rèn shi
examples.en: I don't know all of these characters.

examples.py: tā men bù dōu xǐ huan hē kā fēi
examples.en: Not all of them like coffee.

rules.note: In speech 不是都 is just as common as 不都 (他们不是都喜欢喝咖啡) and means the same.

rules.rule: After a phrase with 每, put 都 before the verb.
rules.pattern: 每 + measure (+ noun) + 都 + Verb

examples.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu hē kā fēi
examples.en: I drink coffee every day.

examples.py: měi gè rén dōu yǒu yī běn shū
examples.en: Everyone has a book.

examples.py: tā měi cì dōu chí dào
examples.en: He is late every time.

rules.note: This is a strong habit, not an absolute law: 都 is sometimes left out, especially when the predicate gives an amount (每人一本, 每天工作八个小时). As a learner, add 都 after 每 unless the predicate is a number phrase.

rules.rule: Question word + 都 means every or any; with 不 / 没 it means none at all. The question word always comes before 都, even when it is the object.
rules.pattern: (Subject) + 什么 / 谁 / 哪儿 + 都 + (不 / 没) + Verb

examples.py: shéi dōu zhī dào zhè jiàn shì
examples.en: Everyone knows about this.

examples.py: wǒ shén me dōu xiǎng chī
examples.en: I want to eat everything.

examples.py: tā nǎ r dōu bù xiǎng qù
examples.en: He doesn't want to go anywhere.

examples.py: wǒ shén me yě méi mǎi
examples.en: I didn't buy anything.

rules.note: In negative sentences 都 and 也 are both fine (什么都没买 = 什么也没买). In affirmative sentences use 都.

rules.rule: For 'not at all', put 一点儿 first, then 也 or 都, then 不 / 没. For 'not even one', use 一 + measure + noun in the same slot.
rules.pattern: Subject + 一点儿 / 一 + measure + noun + 也 / 都 + 不 / 没 + predicate

examples.py: wǒ yī diǎn r yě bù lèi
examples.en: I am not tired at all.

examples.py: zhè ge cài yī diǎn r dōu bù là
examples.en: This dish is not spicy at all.

examples.py: tā yī jù huà yě méi shuō
examples.en: He didn't say a single word.

examples.zh: 这儿的人我一个也不认识。
examples.py: zhè r de rén wǒ yī gè yě bù rèn shi
examples.en: I don't know a single person here.

rules.note: 也 and 都 are interchangeable in this pattern. It is only used with a negative; there is no affirmative 一点儿也累.

rules.rule: 都 + time, age, amount or state + 了 means 'already', with a tone of 'so late / so old / so much'. The 了 at the end is required.
rules.pattern: 都 + time / age / amount / state + 了

examples.zh: 都十二点了，你怎么还不睡？
examples.py: dōu shí èr diǎn le nǐ zěn me hái bù shuì
examples.en: It's already twelve o'clock. Why aren't you asleep yet?

examples.zh: 他都八十岁了，身体还很好。
examples.py: tā dōu bā shí suì le shēn tǐ hái hěn hǎo
examples.en: He is already eighty and still in good health.

examples.zh: 都快十点了，他还没起床。
examples.py: dōu kuài shí diǎn le tā hái méi qǐ chuáng
examples.en: It's nearly ten already and he still hasn't got up.

rules.note: 已经 can replace this 都 or be added after it (都已经十二点了); 都 alone sounds more emotional. 才 is the opposite: 才十二点 means 'it's only twelve'.

right.py: wǒ men dōu xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài

contrasts.why: English says 'all of us', but 都 is an adverb: it follows the subject it totals and stands before the verb.

right.py: zhè xiē shū wǒ dōu kàn le
right.en: I have read all of these books.

contrasts.why: 都 can only total something to its left. The books must be moved in front of 都; 我 alone gives it nothing to total.

right.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē kā fēi

contrasts.why: English 'too' goes at the end, but 也 can never end a sentence. It goes after the subject, before the verb.

right.py: wǒ yě xiǎng qù běi jīng
right.en: I want to go to Beijing too.

contrasts.why: 也 cannot come before the subject. It follows the subject and precedes the modal verb 想.

right.py: tā men yě dōu shì lǎo shī

contrasts.why: When both appear the order is always 也 then 都.

right.py: wǒ yě bù xǐ huan zhè ge yán sè
right.en: I don't like this colour either.

contrasts.why: 也 comes before 不. 'Not ... either' is 也不, never 不也 in a plain statement.

contrasts.wrong: 他们都不是中国人，只有小王是。

right.zh: 他们不都是中国人，只有小王是。
right.py: tā men bù dōu shì zhōng guó rén zhǐ yǒu xiǎo wáng shì
right.en: They are not all Chinese; only Xiao Wang is.

contrasts.why: 都不是 means none of them are, which contradicts 只有小王是. 'Not all' needs 不 in front of 都.

right.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu hē kā fēi

contrasts.why: 都 pairs with 每天 and stands before the verb, never between the verb and its object.

right.py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
right.en: I don't want to eat anything.

contrasts.why: For a firm 'nothing at all', 什么 moves in front of 都 and the negative follows. 我不想吃什么 only means 'there's nothing in particular I want to eat'.

right.py: wǒ yī diǎn r yě bù lèi
right.en: I am not tired at all.

contrasts.why: The order is fixed: 一点儿, then 也 or 都, then 不, then the adjective.

cheat: 都 and 也 are adverbs: after the subject, before the verb. Never first, never last.
都 looks left. 'All' of the object? Move the object in front of 都.
Both together: 也都, never 都也.
Before 不 / 没: 也不, 都没. 都不 = none; 不都 = not all.
See 每, or 什么 / 谁 / 哪儿 meaning 'every' or 'any'? Add 都 before the verb.
Not at all: 一点儿 + 也 / 都 + 不. Not even one: 一 + measure + 也 / 都 + 没.
都 + time or age + 了 = 'already (so late, so old)'. Keep the 了; 才 means the opposite.

items.q: 医生说我现在不能运动，所以这个周末我___都不去，只在家休息。
items.zh: 医生说我现在不能运动，所以这个周末我哪儿都不去，只在家休息。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ xiàn zài bù néng yùn dòng suǒ yǐ zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ nǎ r dōu bù qù zhǐ zài jiā xiū xi
items.en: The doctor says I can't exercise now, so this weekend I'm not going anywhere and will just rest at home.
items.why: 'Not going anywhere' is 哪儿都不去, with 哪儿 in front of 都. 什么 or 谁 cannot be a destination.

items.q: 他每次开会___迟到。
items.zh: 他每次开会都迟到。
items.py: tā měi cì kāi huì dōu chí dào
items.en: He is late for every meeting.
items.why: 每次 is followed by 都 before the verb. 也 would say he is late as well as someone else, and 才 or 再 do not fit with 每次.

items.s: 他八十岁都了，身体还很好。
items.s_py: tā bā shí suì dōu le shēn tǐ hái hěn hǎo
items.zh: 他都八十岁了，身体还很好。
items.py: tā dōu bā shí suì le shēn tǐ hái hěn hǎo
items.en: He's already eighty and still in good health.
items.why: 'Already' 都 comes before the age expression, with 了 at the end. 八十岁都了 reverses that.

items.s_py: wǒ xǐ huan hē chá yě
items.zh: 我也喜欢喝茶。
items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē chá
items.en: I like drinking tea too.
items.why: 也 can never end a sentence. It goes after the subject and before the verb.

items.task: Say that you drink coffee too.
items.zh: 我也喝咖啡。
items.py: wǒ yě hē kā fēi
items.en: I drink coffee too.
items.why: 也 goes after the subject and before the verb. English puts 'too' at the end, but 也 can never end a sentence.

items.s_py: zhè jǐ tiān tā dōu zài yī yuàn
items.zh: 这几天他都在医院。
items.py: zhè jǐ tiān tā dōu zài yī yuàn
items.en: He has been at the hospital all these days.
items.why: 都 can total a time phrase to its left, so it is fine here even though 他 is one person.

items.q: 这些客户我___认识，只认识两三个。
items.zh: 这些客户我不都认识，只认识两三个。
items.py: zhè xiē kè hù wǒ bù dōu rèn shi zhǐ rèn shi liǎng sān gè
items.en: I don't know all of these clients; I only know two or three.
items.why: 不都 means 'not all', which fits knowing just two or three. 都不认识 would mean knowing none of them, which contradicts 只认识两三个.

items.s_py: wǒ měi tiān chī dōu zǎo fàn
items.zh: 我每天都吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu chī zǎo fàn
items.en: I eat breakfast every day.
items.why: 都 follows the 每天 phrase and precedes the verb. It cannot be wedged between the verb and its object.

items.s_py: zhè xiē wén jiàn dōu wǒ kàn guo le
items.zh: 这些文件我都看过了。
items.py: zhè xiē wén jiàn wǒ dōu kàn guo le
items.en: I've read all of these files.
items.why: 都 is an adverb and must stand directly before the verb, after the subject 我. It cannot sit between the fronted object and the subject.

items.q: 爸爸和妈妈___头疼。
items.zh: 爸爸和妈妈都头疼。
items.py: bà ba hé mā ma dōu tóu téng
items.en: Both Dad and Mum have a headache.
items.why: Chinese has no separate word for 'both': two people joined by 和 are totalled by 都. 也 would need an earlier person who had a headache as well.

items.q: 我最近胃不舒服，不吃辣的，___不喝咖啡。
items.zh: 我最近胃不舒服，不吃辣的，也不喝咖啡。
items.py: wǒ zuì jìn wèi bù shū fu bù chī là de yě bù hē kā fēi
items.en: My stomach has been upset lately; I don't eat spicy food, and I don't drink coffee either.
items.why: 'Don't ... either' is 也不, with 也 before 不. 很 and 会 do not mean 'either', and 才不 would be an emphatic denial.

items.q: 同事们___很忙。
items.zh: 同事们都很忙。
items.py: tóng shì men dōu hěn máng
items.en: My colleagues are all very busy.
items.why: 都 totals the plural subject 同事们 and sits right before 很忙. 也 would mean 'too', adding them to someone already mentioned, but the cue says 'all'.

items.zh: 办公室的人也都觉得很冷。
items.py: bàn gōng shì de rén yě dōu jué de hěn lěng
items.en: Everyone in the office feels cold too.
items.why: Both adverbs follow the subject and precede 觉得, in the order 也 then 都.

items.zh: 开会的时候他一句话也没说。
items.py: kāi huì de shí hou tā yī jù huà yě méi shuō
items.en: He didn't say a single word during the meeting.
items.why: 一句话 + 也 + 没 + verb means 'not even one word'. The negative 没 is required and comes after 也.

items.q: 每个同事___会用这个软件。
items.zh: 每个同事都会用这个软件。
items.py: měi gè tóng shì dōu huì yòng zhè ge ruǎn jiàn
items.en: Every colleague can use this software.
items.why: 每个 + noun calls for 都 before the verb phrase. 也 would add a second fact, and 就 and 才 give 'then' or 'only then'.

items.zh: 这些邮件我都回了。
items.py: zhè xiē yóu jiàn wǒ dōu huí le
items.en: I've replied to all of these emails.
items.why: 都 can only total something to its left, so the emails move in front of 都. With 我 alone to its left, 都 would have nothing to total.

items.q: 每天早上我___先量体温，然后再吃药。
items.zh: 每天早上我都先量体温，然后再吃药。
items.py: měi tiān zǎo shang wǒ dōu xiān liáng tǐ wēn rán hòu zài chī yào
items.en: Every morning I take my temperature first and then take my medicine.
items.why: After 每天早上 the habit is marked with 都, placed before 先量体温. 也, 才 and 又 would change the meaning to 'also', 'only then' or 'again'.

items.q: 孩子___咳嗽了半个月了，你怎么现在才带他去医院？
items.zh: 孩子都咳嗽了半个月了，你怎么现在才带他去医院？
items.py: hái zi dōu ké sou le bàn gè yuè le nǐ zěn me xiàn zài cái dài tā qù yī yuàn
items.en: The child has been coughing for half a month already; why are you only taking him to the hospital now?
items.why: 都 ... 了 means 'already half a month', which explains the criticism that follows. 才 would make half a month sound short.

items.task: Make it negative: none of us went.
items.zh: 我们都没去。
items.py: wǒ men dōu méi qù
items.en: None of us went.
items.why: 都 stays before the negative: 都没 means none of us. 没 replaces 了, and the two cannot appear together.

items.task: Say you are not hungry at all (一点儿 + 都).
items.zh: 我一点儿都不饿。
items.py: wǒ yī diǎn r dōu bù è
items.en: I'm not hungry at all.
items.why: 'Not at all' is 一点儿, then 都 (or 也), then 不, then the adjective. The negative stays in the sentence.

items.zh: 医生和护士都想休息。
items.py: yī shēng hé hù shi dōu xiǎng xiū xi
items.en: The doctors and nurses all want to rest.
items.why: 都 totals the joined subject and stands before the modal 想, not after it and not at the end.

items.q: 这几天我们办公室___很冷。
items.zh: 这几天我们办公室都很冷。
items.py: zhè jǐ tiān wǒ men bàn gōng shì dōu hěn lěng
items.en: Our office has been cold all these past few days.
items.why: 都 can total the time phrase 这几天 to its left (every one of these days). 也 would add this to some other place or time already mentioned, which the cue does not do.

items.zh: 这些药我都吃了。
items.py: zhè xiē yào wǒ dōu chī le
items.en: I've taken all of these medicines.
items.why: The medicines are what 'all' refers to, so they stand before 都. Putting them after the verb would leave 都 totalling only 我.

items.q: 这份报告我检查了三遍，一个错字___没发现。
items.zh: 这份报告我检查了三遍，一个错字也没发现。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào wǒ jiǎn chá le sān biàn yī gè cuò zì yě méi fā xiàn
items.en: I checked this report three times and didn't find a single typo.
items.why: 一 + measure + noun + 也 + 没 gives 'not even one'. 就, 又 and 再 cannot take the 也/都 slot in this negative pattern.

items.q: 这些药我吃过，那些药我___都吃过。
items.zh: 这些药我吃过，那些药我也都吃过。
items.py: zhè xiē yào wǒ chī guo nà xiē yào wǒ yě dōu chī guo
items.en: I've taken these medicines, and I've taken all of those too.
items.why: The fronted object 那些药 lets 都 total it, and 也 ('too') must come before 都. 就, 才 and 只 would give 'right away' or 'only'.

items.zh: 这几天大家都在加班。
items.py: zhè jǐ tiān dà jiā dōu zài jiā bān
items.en: Everyone has been working overtime these past few days.
items.why: 都 must follow what it totals and precede 在加班. The time phrase may come before or after 大家.

items.q: 我最近睡得不好，小王说他最近___睡得不好。
items.zh: 我最近睡得不好，小王说他最近也睡得不好。
items.py: wǒ zuì jìn shuì de bù hǎo xiǎo wáng shuō tā zuì jìn yě shuì de bù hǎo
items.en: I haven't been sleeping well lately, and Xiao Wang says he hasn't been sleeping well lately either.
items.why: 也 comes after the subject and its time word, right before the predicate 睡得不好. 都 needs a plural subject, and 就 or 才 do not mean 'either'.

items.q: 这个问题很简单，___都会做。
items.zh: 这个问题很简单，谁都会做。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí hěn jiǎn dān shéi dōu huì zuò
items.en: This problem is very easy; anyone can do it.
items.why: 谁 + 都 means 'anyone', the person who can do it. 哪儿 and 怎么 do not name a person.

items.q: 我们___没有时间。
items.zh: 我们都没有时间。
items.py: wǒ men dōu méi yǒu shí jiān
items.en: None of us has time.
items.why: 都 before 没 means none of us. 也 would mean 'we also have no time', and 不 cannot negate 有.

items.s: 每次开会，他都带着笔记本。
items.s_py: měi cì kāi huì tā dōu dài zhe bǐ jì běn
items.zh: 每次开会，他都带着笔记本。
items.py: měi cì kāi huì tā dōu dài zhe bǐ jì běn
items.en: At every meeting he brings his notebook.
items.why: 每次 is followed by 都 before the verb, so the sentence is correct.

items.zh: 这些病人不都需要住院。
items.py: zhè xiē bìng rén bù dōu xū yào zhù yuàn
items.en: Not all of these patients need to be hospitalised.
items.why: 不 before 都 means 'not all'. 都不 would mean none of them need it.

items.zh: 我什么都不想吃。
items.py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
items.en: I don't want to eat anything.
items.why: What is eaten, 什么, moves in front of 都 and the negative follows. 我不想吃什么 would not give a firm 'nothing at all'.

items.q: 我的感冒___一个星期了，还没好。
items.zh: 我的感冒都一个星期了，还没好。
items.py: wǒ de gǎn mào dōu yī gè xīng qī le hái méi hǎo
items.en: I've had this cold for a whole week already and it still hasn't gone.
items.why: 都 + a stretch of time + 了 means 'already so long'. 才 would make a week sound short, and 也 would mean 'also'.

items.zh: 他们也都是医生。
items.py: tā men yě dōu shì yī shēng
items.en: They are all doctors too.
items.why: The fixed order is 也 then 都, both after the plural subject and before 是.

items.s: 这些报告他们也都看过了。
items.s_py: zhè xiē bào gào tā men yě dōu kàn guo le
items.zh: 这些报告他们也都看过了。
items.py: zhè xiē bào gào tā men yě dōu kàn guo le
items.en: They have read all of these reports too.
items.why: The object is fronted so 都 can total it, and 也 stands before 都. The order 也都 is correct.

items.s: 他一口水也没喝就去开会了。
items.s_py: tā yī kǒu shuǐ yě méi hē jiù qù kāi huì le
items.zh: 他一口水也没喝就去开会了。
items.py: tā yī kǒu shuǐ yě méi hē jiù qù kāi huì le
items.en: He went to the meeting without drinking a single mouthful of water.
items.why: 一 + measure + noun + 也 + 没 + verb means 'not even one'. The negative 没 is present, so it is correct.

items.zh: 我每天都吃药。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu chī yào
items.en: I take medicine every day.
items.why: 都 follows the 每天 phrase and comes before the verb. It cannot go between the verb and its object.

items.s: 同事们不都来了，办公室里一个人也没有。
items.s_py: tóng shì men bù dōu lái le bàn gōng shì lǐ yī gè rén yě méi yǒu
items.zh: 同事们都没来，办公室里一个人也没有。
items.py: tóng shì men dōu méi lái bàn gōng shì lǐ yī gè rén yě méi yǒu
items.en: None of my colleagues came; there isn't a single person in the office.
items.why: 不都 means only some came, which clashes with an empty office. 'None' needs 都没.

items.zh: 最近我也常常觉得很累。
items.py: zuì jìn wǒ yě cháng cháng jué de hěn lèi
items.en: I've often been feeling very tired lately too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject (with its time word) and precedes the adverb 常常 and the verb. It cannot open or close the sentence.

items.q: 我什么___想吃。
items.zh: 我什么都想吃。
items.py: wǒ shén me dōu xiǎng chī
items.en: I want to eat everything.
items.why: 什么 + 都 means 'everything' or 'anything' in a positive sentence, and 都 sits before 想. 也 is for negative sentences.

items.q: 这几个病人___没发烧，不用担心。
items.zh: 这几个病人都没发烧，不用担心。
items.py: zhè jǐ gè bìng rén dōu méi fā shāo bù yòng dān xīn
items.en: None of these patients has a fever, so don't worry.
items.why: 都 before 没 means none of them has a fever. 还没 would mean 'not yet', which is a different message.

items.s_py: wǒ men dōu yě qù kāi huì
items.zh: 我们也都去开会。
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu qù kāi huì
items.en: We are all going to the meeting too.
items.why: When both adverbs appear 也 must come first: 也都. 都也 is not Chinese.

items.q: 我今天一点儿___不累。
items.zh: 我今天一点儿也不累。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān yī diǎn r yě bù lèi
items.en: I'm not tired at all today.
items.why: 'Not at all' is 一点儿 + 也 + 不 + adjective. 还 would give 'not yet', and 就 and 才 cannot sit in this slot.

items.zh: 这些药我也都吃过。
items.py: zhè xiē yào wǒ yě dōu chī guo
items.en: I've taken all of these medicines too.
items.why: The object is fronted so 都 can total it, and 也 stands before 都: 也都.

items.q: 头很疼，我今天___都不想去。
items.zh: 头很疼，我今天哪儿都不想去。
items.py: tóu hěn téng wǒ jīn tiān nǎ r dōu bù xiǎng qù
items.en: My head hurts so much that I don't want to go anywhere today.
items.why: 'Anywhere' with 去 is 哪儿, placed before 都 and the negative. 什么 or 谁 cannot be the place you go to.

items.q: 医生说我要多休息，我爸妈___都要多休息。
items.zh: 医生说我要多休息，我爸妈也都要多休息。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ yào duō xiū xi wǒ bà mā yě dōu yào duō xiū xi
items.en: The doctor said I need more rest, and my mum and dad both need more rest too.
items.why: 'Too' plus 'both' means 也都, with 也 first. 就, 才 and 会 cannot take the 'too' slot in front of 都.

items.zh: 他们都没来。
items.py: tā men dōu méi lái
items.en: None of them came.
items.why: 都 goes before 没 and means none of them. Putting 没 first (没都来) would turn it into 'not all of them came'.

items.q: 小王和小李___在新公司上班。
items.zh: 小王和小李都在新公司上班。
items.py: xiǎo wáng hé xiǎo lǐ dōu zài xīn gōng sī shàng bān
items.en: Xiao Wang and Xiao Li both work at the new company.
items.why: 都 totals the two people and stands before the 在 phrase. 还 means 'still', so it would not give 'both' at all.

items.zh: 小李也想换工作。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ yě xiǎng huàn gōng zuò
items.en: Xiao Li wants to change jobs too.
items.why: 也 comes after the subject and before the modal verb 想. It is not placed after 想 or at the end.

items.s_py: tā yě zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò
items.zh: 他也在这家公司工作。
items.py: tā yě zài zhè jiā gōng sī gōng zuò
items.en: He works at this company too.
items.why: 也 goes before the whole 在 phrase, right after the subject, so this order is correct.

items.zh: 我们都想在家上班。
items.py: wǒ men dōu xiǎng zài jiā shàng bān
items.en: We all want to work from home.
items.why: 都 totals 我们 and sits before the modal 想. It cannot follow the 在家 phrase or come after the verb, so 想在家都上班 and 我们想在家上班都 are wrong.

items.zh: 我也不知道。
items.py: wǒ yě bù zhī dào
items.en: I don't know either.
items.why: 也 comes before 不, so 'not ... either' is 也不. 不也 is not possible in a plain statement.

items.zh: 我们也都去。
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu qù
items.en: We are all going too.
items.why: When both adverbs appear, 也 comes before 都. 都也 is not possible.

items.q: 我每天___去公司上班。
items.zh: 我每天都去公司上班。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu qù gōng sī shàng bān
items.en: I go to work at the company every day.
items.why: A 每 phrase such as 每天 is followed by 都 before the verb. 也 would mean 'also', and 才 or 就 add timing meanings that the cue does not have.

items.s: 这几份报告都没有错，经理很满意。
items.s_py: zhè jǐ fèn bào gào dōu méi yǒu cuò jīng lǐ hěn mǎn yì
items.zh: 这几份报告都没有错，经理很满意。
items.py: zhè jǐ fèn bào gào dōu méi yǒu cuò jīng lǐ hěn mǎn yì
items.en: None of these reports has a mistake, and the manager is very satisfied.
items.why: 都没有 means none of them has a mistake, which is exactly why the manager is satisfied. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 他___六十岁了，还每天去公司上班。
items.zh: 他都六十岁了，还每天去公司上班。
items.py: tā dōu liù shí suì le hái měi tiān qù gōng sī shàng bān
items.en: He's already sixty and still goes to the office every day.
items.why: 都 + age + 了 stresses 'already that old', setting up the contrast with 还每天上班. 才 and 只 would make sixty sound young.

items.q: 他开了两个小时的会，一句话___没说。
items.zh: 他开了两个小时的会，一句话也没说。
items.py: tā kāi le liǎng gè xiǎo shí de huì yī jù huà yě méi shuō
items.en: He was in the meeting for two hours and didn't say a single word.
items.why: 'Not even one' is 一 + measure + noun, then 也 + 没 + verb. 才, 又 and 再 would give 'only', 'again' or 'then'.

items.zh: 他每次都迟到。
items.py: tā měi cì dōu chí dào
items.en: He is late every time.
items.why: A 每 phrase is followed by 都 before the verb. The 每 phrase may stand before or after 他.

items.zh: 医生说我什么都不能吃。
items.py: yī shēng shuō wǒ shén me dōu bù néng chī
items.en: The doctor says I can't eat anything.
items.why: 什么 comes before 都 and the negative modal 不能 follows. 我不能吃什么 would not mean 'nothing at all'.

items.s_py: wǒ men chī dōu wǔ fàn
items.zh: 我们都吃午饭。
items.py: wǒ men dōu chī wǔ fàn
items.en: We all eat lunch.
items.why: 都 must come before the verb, directly after the subject it totals. 吃都午饭 wedges it between the verb and its object.

items.q: 你___吃了三碗饭了，还要吃吗？
items.zh: 你都吃了三碗饭了，还要吃吗？
items.py: nǐ dōu chī le sān wǎn fàn le hái yào chī ma
items.en: You've already eaten three bowls of rice; do you still want more?
items.why: 都 ... 了 shows the speaker finds three bowls a lot. 才 would mean 'only three bowls', the opposite of the question about eating more.

items.zh: 这两个方案经理都不同意。
items.py: zhè liǎng gè fāng àn jīng lǐ dōu bù tóng yì
items.en: The manager doesn't agree with either of these two plans.
items.why: 都 totals the two plans, so they come before it. The negative 不 follows 都, giving 'neither'.

items.q: 我的腿一点儿___不疼。
items.zh: 我的腿一点儿都不疼。
items.py: wǒ de tuǐ yī diǎn r dōu bù téng
items.en: My leg doesn't hurt at all.
items.why: 一点儿 + 都 + 不 means 'not at all', placed before the adjective 疼. 又, 再 and 会 do not belong in this fixed frame.

items.q: ___十二点了，你怎么还不睡觉？
items.zh: 都十二点了，你怎么还不睡觉？
items.py: dōu shí èr diǎn le nǐ zěn me hái bù shuì jiào
items.en: It's already twelve; why aren't you asleep yet?
items.why: 都 + time + 了 means 'already so late', which suits the complaint that follows. 才 and 只 would mean 'only twelve', the opposite attitude.

items.src_py: wǒ kàn wán le zhè xiē wén jiàn
items.task: Say you finished ALL of these files: put the files in front and use 都.
items.zh: 这些文件我都看完了。
items.py: zhè xiē wén jiàn wǒ dōu kàn wán le
items.en: I've finished reading all of these files.
items.why: To say 'all of the files', the object moves before 都, which totals what is to its left. The result 完 and 了 stay.

items.q: 办公室里的人___喝咖啡，所以没人去买。
items.zh: 办公室里的人都不喝咖啡，所以没人去买。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ de rén dōu bù hē kā fēi suǒ yǐ méi rén qù mǎi
items.en: None of the people in the office drink coffee, so nobody goes to buy any.
items.why: 都不 means none drink it, which explains why nobody buys it. 不都 would only say some do not drink it, and that would not explain 没人去买.

items.s: 这个检查谁都可以参加。
items.s_py: zhè ge jiǎn chá shéi dōu kě yǐ cān jiā
items.zh: 这个检查谁都可以参加。
items.py: zhè ge jiǎn chá shéi dōu kě yǐ cān jiā
items.en: Anyone can take part in this check-up.
items.why: 谁 + 都 means 'anyone', and the topic 这个检查 can come first. The sentence is correct.

items.q: 我头疼得厉害，一点儿东西___不想吃。
items.zh: 我头疼得厉害，一点儿东西都不想吃。
items.py: wǒ tóu téng de lì hai yī diǎn r dōng xi dōu bù xiǎng chī
items.en: My head hurts terribly, and I don't feel like eating anything at all.
items.why: 一点儿东西 + 都 + 不 means 'nothing at all'. The negative 不 is required. 又, 才 and 就 do not belong in this frame.

items.q: 他们___是医生，只有小李是。
items.zh: 他们不都是医生，只有小李是。
items.py: tā men bù dōu shì yī shēng zhǐ yǒu xiǎo lǐ shì
items.en: They are not all doctors; only Xiao Li is.
items.why: 'Not all' is 不都. 都不是 would mean none of them are doctors, which contradicts 只有小李是.

items.q: 小王是医生，我___是医生。
items.zh: 小王是医生，我也是医生。
items.py: xiǎo wáng shì yī shēng wǒ yě shì yī shēng
items.en: Xiao Wang is a doctor, and I am a doctor too.
items.why: 也 adds 我 to what was just said about 小王 and goes before 是. 都 needs a plural to total, and 我 is only one person.

items.s_py: wǒ men bù dōu shì yī shēng
items.zh: 我们不都是医生。
items.py: wǒ men bù dōu shì yī shēng
items.en: Not all of us are doctors.
items.why: 不都 is the correct way to say 'not all'. It does not mean none; 都不 would.

items.s_py: tā dōu shén me bù chī
items.zh: 他什么都不吃。
items.py: tā shén me dōu bù chī
items.en: He doesn't eat anything.
items.why: The question word must come before 都: 什么都不吃. 都 cannot stand in front of the thing it totals.

items.s_py: wǒ de tuǐ yī diǎn r yě téng
items.zh: 我的腿一点儿也不疼。
items.py: wǒ de tuǐ yī diǎn r yě bù téng
items.en: My leg doesn't hurt at all.
items.why: 一点儿也 only works with a negative. 'Not at all' needs 不 after 也, so 一点儿也疼 is wrong.

items.src_py: tā men dōu xǐ huan jiā bān
items.task: Say that NOT ALL of them like working overtime.
items.zh: 他们不都喜欢加班。
items.py: tā men bù dōu xǐ huan jiā bān
items.en: Not all of them like working overtime.
items.why: 'Not all' puts 不 before 都. 都不喜欢 would say that none of them like it.

items.q: 这件事谁___知道。
items.zh: 这件事谁都知道。
items.py: zhè jiàn shì shéi dōu zhī dào
items.en: Everyone knows about this.
items.why: 谁 + 都 in a positive sentence means 'everyone'. 也 is for negatives, and 才 or 就 do not give 'everyone'.

items.q: 我不知道，他___不知道。
items.zh: 我不知道，他也不知道。
items.py: wǒ bù zhī dào tā yě bù zhī dào
items.en: I don't know, and he doesn't know either.
items.why: English 'either' is still 也 in Chinese, and it goes before 不. 都 needs a plural subject, and 他 is one person.

items.zh: 我一点儿也不累。
items.py: wǒ yī diǎn r yě bù lèi
items.en: I'm not tired at all.
items.why: The order is fixed: 一点儿, then 也, then 不, then the adjective. 不一点儿累 is impossible.

items.s_py: wǒ bù yě xiǎng qù
items.zh: 我也不想去。
items.py: wǒ yě bù xiǎng qù
items.en: I don't want to go either.
items.why: 也 must come before 不: 'not ... either' is 也不. 不也 is not possible in a plain statement.

items.zh: 我明天也去公司。
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yě qù gōng sī
items.en: I'm going to the office tomorrow too.
items.why: The time word may come before or after the subject, but 也 comes after both and before the verb.

items.zh: 办公室里谁都不抽烟。
items.py: bàn gōng shì lǐ shéi dōu bù chōu yān
items.en: Nobody in the office smokes.
items.why: 谁 + 都 + 不 gives 'nobody'. The question word stays before 都 and the negative 不 follows it.

items.s_py: yě wǒ jīn tiān qù yī yuàn
items.zh: 我今天也去医院。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān yě qù yī yuàn
items.en: I'm going to the hospital today too.
items.why: 也 cannot open a sentence or come before the subject. It follows the subject and any time word, then precedes the verb.

items.q: 我感冒了，___都不想吃。
items.zh: 我感冒了，什么都不想吃。
items.py: wǒ gǎn mào le shén me dōu bù xiǎng chī
items.en: I've caught a cold and don't want to eat anything.
items.why: What is eaten is 什么. The question word sits before 都 even though it is the object. 谁 and 哪儿 do not fit as things to eat.

items.q: 李医生在这家医院工作，他太太___在这家医院工作。
items.zh: 李医生在这家医院工作，他太太也在这家医院工作。
items.py: lǐ yī shēng zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò tā tài tai yě zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: Doctor Li works at this hospital, and his wife works at this hospital too.
items.why: 也 goes after the subject 他太太 and before the whole 在 phrase. 都 would need two or more people to its left.

items.zh: 我也是医生。
items.py: wǒ yě shì yī shēng
items.en: I am a doctor too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject and comes right before 是. It cannot go at the end the way English 'too' does.

items.zh: 他也想在这家医院工作。
items.py: tā yě xiǎng zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: He wants to work at this hospital too.
items.why: 也 sits right after the subject, before the modal 想 and the whole 在 phrase. It cannot follow 想 or the place phrase, and it cannot end the sentence.

items.q: 小王去开会，我们___都去。
items.zh: 小王去开会，我们也都去。
items.py: xiǎo wáng qù kāi huì wǒ men yě dōu qù
items.en: Xiao Wang is going to the meeting, and we are all going too.
items.why: When both adverbs appear, 也 comes before 都 (也都). 都也 is impossible, and 还 or 又 do not mean 'too' here.

items.q: 这次体检，公司的人___要抽血。
items.zh: 这次体检，公司的人都要抽血。
items.py: zhè cì tǐ jiǎn gōng sī de rén dōu yào chōu xuè
items.en: At this check-up, everyone at the company has to have blood taken.
items.why: 都 totals 公司的人 and comes before the modal 要. 也 would only add them to a group already named, and 只 or 才 give 'only', not 'everyone'.

items.q: 每次体检的时候，他___紧张得睡不着觉。
items.zh: 每次体检的时候，他都紧张得睡不着觉。
items.py: měi cì tǐ jiǎn de shí hou tā dōu jǐn zhāng de shuì bù zháo jiào
items.en: Every time he has a medical check-up, he is so nervous he can't sleep.
items.why: 每次 sets up a repeated pattern, so 都 goes before the verb phrase. 也 would mean 'also nervous', and 只 or 才 mean 'only'.

items.zh: 我今天也没吃早饭。
items.py: wǒ jīn tiān yě méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: I didn't eat breakfast today either.
items.why: 也 comes before 没, after the subject and time word. 没也吃 is not possible.

items.q: 经理明天去上海，我___想去。
items.zh: 经理明天去上海，我也想去。
items.py: jīng lǐ míng tiān qù shàng hǎi wǒ yě xiǎng qù
items.en: The manager is going to Shanghai tomorrow, and I want to go too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject 我 and comes before the modal 想. 都 needs a plural subject, and 就想去 would mean 'just want to go', not 'too'.

items.zh: 他都八十岁了。
items.py: tā dōu bā shí suì le
items.en: He is already eighty.
items.why: 都 before the age and 了 at the end give 'already so old'. Without 了 the sentence is unfinished.

items.zh: 医生们都很累。
items.py: yī shēng men dōu hěn lèi
items.en: The doctors are all very tired.
items.why: 都 totals 医生们 and stands before the adjective phrase. English 'all' after the noun tempts you to put 都 at the end, which is wrong.

items.q: 销售部的人是新来的，技术部的人___都是新同事。
items.zh: 销售部的人是新来的，技术部的人也都是新同事。
items.py: xiāo shòu bù de rén shì xīn lái de jì shù bù de rén yě dōu shì xīn tóng shì
items.en: The people in sales are new arrivals, and the people in the technical department are all new colleagues too.
items.why: The first group is new and the second is new as well, so 也 is needed, and it must precede 都: 也都. 才, 就 and 又 cannot fill this slot with the meaning 'too'.

items.zh: 每个病人都要吃药。
items.py: měi gè bìng rén dōu yào chī yào
items.en: Every patient has to take medicine.
items.why: 都 follows the 每个 phrase and stands before the modal 要. Leaving it out or moving it after 要 is wrong.

items.q: 我昨天加班了，今天___要加班。
items.zh: 我昨天加班了，今天也要加班。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān jiā bān le jīn tiān yě yào jiā bān
items.en: I worked overtime yesterday, and I have to work overtime today too.
items.why: 也 links today's overtime to yesterday's and stands before 要. 都 would need a plural to total, and 才 or 就 add the wrong meaning ('only then', 'right away').

items.q: 他头疼，我___头疼。
items.zh: 他头疼，我也头疼。
items.py: tā tóu téng wǒ yě tóu téng
items.en: He has a headache, and so do I.
items.why: 也 means 'too' and goes between the subject 我 and the verb. 还 would mean 'still', which does not link my headache to his.

items.s_py: wǒ zhè xiē bào gào dōu xiě wán le
items.zh: 我这些报告都写完了。
items.py: wǒ zhè xiē bào gào dōu xiě wán le
items.en: I have finished writing all of these reports.
items.why: The object may sit between the subject and 都, as long as it stands before 都 so that 都 can total it.

items.zh: 今天的工作我都做完了。
items.py: jīn tiān de gōng zuò wǒ dōu zuò wán le
items.en: I have finished all of today's work.
items.why: 'All of the work' needs the object in front of 都. The object can sit before or after the subject 我, but always before 都.

items.q: 小李没去开会，小王___没去。
items.zh: 小李没去开会，小王也没去。
items.py: xiǎo lǐ méi qù kāi huì xiǎo wáng yě méi qù
items.en: Xiao Li didn't go to the meeting, and Xiao Wang didn't either.
items.why: 'Didn't either' is 也没, with 也 before 没. 都 needs a plural subject to total.

items.q: ___到下班时间了，经理怎么还在开会？
items.zh: 都到下班时间了，经理怎么还在开会？
items.py: dōu dào xià bān shí jiān le jīng lǐ zěn me hái zài kāi huì
items.en: It's already time to get off work; why is the manager still in a meeting?
items.why: 都 ... 了 means 'already', matching the surprise in 怎么还在开会. 才 and 只 would suggest it is still early.

items.q: 我们三个人___喜欢踢足球。
items.zh: 我们三个人都喜欢踢足球。
items.py: wǒ men sān gè rén dōu xǐ huan tī zú qiú
items.en: All three of us like playing football.
items.why: 都 totals 我们三个人 and sits right before 喜欢. 也 would add 'too', which the English does not say.

items.q: 这两件衣服___很便宜。
items.zh: 这两件衣服都很便宜。
items.py: zhè liǎng jiàn yī fu dōu hěn pián yi
items.en: Both of these garments are very cheap.
items.why: Two items are totalled, so 都 goes before 很便宜 (Chinese has no separate 'both'). 也 would mean 'also cheap' and needs an earlier cheap thing.

items.q: 这几天商店里的东西___在打折。
items.zh: 这几天商店里的东西都在打折。
items.py: zhè jǐ tiān shāng diàn lǐ de dōng xi dōu zài dǎ zhé
items.en: All the things in the shop have been on sale these past few days.
items.why: 都 totals the plural 东西 and stands before 在打折. 也 'also' and 又 'again' add meanings the English does not have.

items.q: 孩子们___想跟爸爸一起去爬山。
items.zh: 孩子们都想跟爸爸一起去爬山。
items.py: hái zi men dōu xiǎng gēn bà ba yī qǐ qù pá shān
items.en: The children all want to go hiking with Dad.
items.why: 都 follows the plural subject 孩子们 and comes before the modal 想. The cue says 'all', not 'too', so 也 is wrong.

items.q: 那些衣服我___买下来了。
items.zh: 那些衣服我都买下来了。
items.py: nà xiē yī fu wǒ dōu mǎi xià lái le
items.en: I bought all of those clothes.
items.why: The object 那些衣服 is fronted so 都 can total it. 也 would mean 'I bought those too'; 才 means 'only then' and does not fit.

items.q: 我喜欢游泳，我哥哥___喜欢。
items.zh: 我喜欢游泳，我哥哥也喜欢。
items.py: wǒ xǐ huan yóu yǒng wǒ gē ge yě xǐ huan
items.en: I like swimming; my older brother likes it too.
items.why: The English says 'too', so 也 goes after 我哥哥 before 喜欢. 都 needs a plural subject; one brother gives it nothing to total.

items.q: 你买这个，我___买这个。
items.zh: 你买这个，我也买这个。
items.py: nǐ mǎi zhè ge wǒ yě mǎi zhè ge
items.en: You're buying this one; I'm buying this one too.
items.why: 也 means 'too' and stands after the subject 我. 又 means 'again', which is not what is said.

items.q: 这个球拍很便宜，那个___很便宜。
items.zh: 这个球拍很便宜，那个也很便宜。
items.py: zhè ge qiú pāi hěn pián yi nà ge yě hěn pián yi
items.en: This racket is cheap; that one is cheap too.
items.why: 'That one is cheap too' needs 也 before 很. 都 would total several things but 那个 is one racket.

items.q: 我周末在公园跑步，小王周末___在公园跑步。
items.zh: 我周末在公园跑步，小王周末也在公园跑步。
items.py: wǒ zhōu mò zài gōng yuán pǎo bù xiǎo wáng zhōu mò yě zài gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: I run in the park at weekends; Xiao Wang runs in the park at weekends too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject (and the time word) and comes before the 在公园 phrase. 又 would mean the same person does it again.

items.q: 我对打羽毛球很感兴趣，他___对羽毛球很感兴趣，所以我们常常一起打。
items.zh: 我对打羽毛球很感兴趣，他也对羽毛球很感兴趣，所以我们常常一起打。
items.py: wǒ duì dǎ yǔ máo qiú hěn gǎn xìng qù tā yě duì yǔ máo qiú hěn gǎn xìng qù suǒ yǐ wǒ men cháng cháng yī qǐ dǎ
items.en: I am keen on badminton and he is keen on it too, so we often play together.
items.why: 'He too' is 他也, and 也 sits before the 对 phrase. 又 adds a repetition meaning, not 'too'.

items.q: 这家店的鞋很好看，价格___很合适。
items.zh: 这家店的鞋很好看，价格也很合适。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de xié hěn hǎo kàn jià gé yě hěn hé shì
items.en: The shoes in this shop look good, and the price is also very reasonable.
items.why: 'Also' for a second quality is 也, placed after 价格 before 很. 都 would need several things to total.

items.q: 我们___买了新鞋。
items.zh: 我们也都买了新鞋。
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu mǎi le xīn xié
items.en: We all bought new shoes too.
items.why: When both are needed, 也 comes first: 也都. 都也 is impossible.

items.q: 你的朋友都喜欢踢足球，我的朋友___喜欢。
items.zh: 你的朋友都喜欢踢足球，我的朋友也都喜欢。
items.py: nǐ de péng you dōu xǐ huan tī zú qiú wǒ de péng you yě dōu xǐ huan
items.en: All your friends like football; all my friends like it too.
items.why: 'All ... too' needs both adverbs, and the fixed order is 也都. 都也 is never said.

items.q: 这家店的肉很便宜，这些菜___很便宜。
items.zh: 这家店的肉很便宜，这些菜也都很便宜。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de ròu hěn pián yi zhè xiē cài yě dōu hěn pián yi
items.en: The meat in this shop is cheap, and these vegetables are all cheap too.
items.why: Another cheap thing ('too') plus a plural total ('all') gives 也都 before 很. The reverse order 都也 does not exist.

items.q: 他们俩都是篮球迷，我和我弟弟___是，所以周末我们四个常常一起看比赛。
items.zh: 他们俩都是篮球迷，我和我弟弟也都是，所以周末我们四个常常一起看比赛。
items.py: tā men liǎ dōu shì lán qiú mí wǒ hé wǒ dì di yě dōu shì suǒ yǐ zhōu mò wǒ men sì gè cháng cháng yī qǐ kàn bǐ sài
items.en: Both of them are basketball fans, and my younger brother and I are both fans too, so the four of us often watch games together on weekends.
items.why: Both 也 ('too') and 都 ('both') are needed, and 也 must precede 都. 都也 is not Chinese.

items.q: 大人爱吃苹果，孩子们___爱吃。
items.zh: 大人爱吃苹果，孩子们也都爱吃。
items.py: dà ren ài chī píng guǒ hái zi men yě dōu ài chī
items.en: Adults love eating apples, and the children all love them too.
items.why: 'Too' (也) and 'all' (都) together are always in the order 也都.

items.q: 我___喜欢这家店，东西太贵了。
items.zh: 我也不喜欢这家店，东西太贵了。
items.py: wǒ yě bù xǐ huan zhè jiā diàn dōng xi tài guì le
items.en: I don't like this shop either; things are too expensive.
items.why: 'Not ... either' is 也不: 也 comes before 不. 不也 is the wrong order in a plain statement.

items.q: 下雨了，我们___没去商店。
items.zh: 下雨了，我们都没去商店。
items.py: xià yǔ le wǒ men dōu méi qù shāng diàn
items.en: It was raining, so none of us went to the shop.
items.why: 都没 means none of us. 也没 would mean 'we didn't go either', which needs an earlier person who also stayed home.

items.q: 昨天下雨，所以我们___去踢球。
items.zh: 昨天下雨，所以我们都没去踢球。
items.py: zuó tiān xià yǔ suǒ yǐ wǒ men dōu méi qù tī qiú
items.en: It rained yesterday, so none of us went to play football.
items.why: 都 comes before 没: 都没去 means none went. 没都 is not a possible order.

items.q: 这些球员___是中国人，有的是上海人，有的是美国人。
items.zh: 这些球员不都是中国人，有的是上海人，有的是美国人。
items.py: zhè xiē qiú yuán bù dōu shì zhōng guó rén yǒu de shì shàng hǎi rén yǒu de shì měi guó rén
items.en: Not all of these players are Chinese; some are from Shanghai and some are American.
items.why: 不都 means 'not all'. 都不是中国人 would say none is Chinese, which contradicts 'some are from Shanghai' (Shanghai people are Chinese).

items.q: 这几家店我___去过，所以哪家好我一点儿也不知道。
items.zh: 这几家店我都没去过，所以哪家好我一点儿也不知道。
items.py: zhè jǐ jiā diàn wǒ dōu méi qù guo suǒ yǐ nǎ jiā hǎo wǒ yī diǎn r yě bù zhī dào
items.en: I haven't been to any of these shops, so I have no idea which is good.
items.why: 'None' is 都没. 不都 would mean not all, implying I know some of them, which clashes with having no idea.

items.q: 来看比赛的人___是学生，也有老师。
items.zh: 来看比赛的人不都是学生，也有老师。
items.py: lái kàn bǐ sài de rén bù dōu shì xué sheng yě yǒu lǎo shī
items.en: Not all the people who came to watch the match are students; there are teachers too.
items.why: 'Not all' is 不都. 都不是 would mean no one is a student, which clashes with 也有老师 ('there are also teachers').

items.q: 这个牌子的运动鞋太贵了，我们___想买，所以只好去别的店看看。
items.zh: 这个牌子的运动鞋太贵了，我们都不想买，所以只好去别的店看看。
items.py: zhè ge pái zi de yùn dòng xié tài guì le wǒ men dōu bù xiǎng mǎi suǒ yǐ zhǐ hǎo qù bié de diàn kàn kan
items.en: These sneakers are too expensive; none of us wants to buy them, so we have to look in other shops.
items.why: 'None of us' is 都不. 不都 would only say some do not want them, and then there would be no need to leave the shop.

items.q: 票价___是一样的，学生票比成人票便宜。
items.zh: 票价不都是一样的，学生票比成人票便宜。
items.py: piào jià bù dōu shì yī yàng de xué sheng piào bǐ chéng rén piào pián yi
items.en: Ticket prices are not all the same; student tickets are cheaper than adult ones.
items.why: 'Not all the same' is 不都. 都不 would say that none of them is the same, which is a different claim.

items.q: 我每天晚上___去公园跑步。
items.zh: 我每天晚上都去公园跑步。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān wǎn shang dōu qù gōng yuán pǎo bù
items.en: I go running in the park every evening.
items.why: A 每 phrase is followed by 都 before the verb. 也 would add 'too'; 才 means 'only then'.

items.q: 每个人___喜欢这家商店。
items.zh: 每个人都喜欢这家商店。
items.py: měi gè rén dōu xǐ huan zhè jiā shāng diàn
items.en: Everyone likes this shop.
items.why: 每个人 needs 都 before the verb. 也 would mean 'also' and has no earlier person to refer back to.

items.q: 他每次买东西___要问价格。
items.zh: 他每次买东西都要问价格。
items.py: tā měi cì mǎi dōng xi dōu yào wèn jià gé
items.en: Every time he shops he asks the price.
items.why: 每次 is followed by 都 before the predicate. 才 and 又 do not mean 'every time'.

items.q: 我们班每个同学___参加了学校的足球比赛。
items.zh: 我们班每个同学都参加了学校的足球比赛。
items.py: wǒ men bān měi gè tóng xué dōu cān jiā le xué xiào de zú qiú bǐ sài
items.en: Every student in our class took part in the school football match.
items.why: 每个同学 calls for 都 before 参加. 也 would only mean 'also took part'.

items.q: 每次比赛前我___很紧张。
items.zh: 每次比赛前我都很紧张。
items.py: měi cì bǐ sài qián wǒ dōu hěn jǐn zhāng
items.en: I am nervous before every match.
items.why: 'Every time' is marked by 都 after the subject, before 很紧张. 又 'again' and 也 'also' do not express 'every'.

items.q: 这家商店的东西每件___打八折，所以周末来买东西的人特别多。
items.zh: 这家商店的东西每件都打八折，所以周末来买东西的人特别多。
items.py: zhè jiā shāng diàn de dōng xi měi jiàn dōu dǎ bā zhé suǒ yǐ zhōu mò lái mǎi dōng xi de rén tè bié duō
items.en: Every item in this shop is 20 percent off, so a great many people come shopping at the weekend.
items.why: 每件 is closed off by 都 before 打八折. 也 would mean 'also 20 percent off'.

items.q: 我什么___想买。
items.zh: 我什么都想买。
items.py: wǒ shén me dōu xiǎng mǎi
items.en: I want to buy everything.
items.why: 什么 + 都 means 'everything'. The question word comes before 都, even though it is the object.

items.q: 谁___知道他是有名的足球运动员。
items.zh: 谁都知道他是有名的足球运动员。
items.py: shéi dōu zhī dào tā shì yǒu míng de zú qiú yùn dòng yuán
items.en: Everyone knows he is a famous football player.
items.why: 谁 + 都 means 'everyone'. In a positive sentence 都 is the word to use; 也 would mean 'also'.

items.q: 今天太累了，我___想去。
items.zh: 今天太累了，我哪儿都不想去。
items.py: jīn tiān tài lèi le wǒ nǎ r dōu bù xiǎng qù
items.en: I'm too tired today; I don't want to go anywhere.
items.why: The pattern is question word, then 都, then 不. 不哪儿都 breaks the order; 哪儿都想去 says the opposite.

items.q: 钱包忘在家里了，我什么___没买。
items.zh: 钱包忘在家里了，我什么都没买。
items.py: qián bāo wàng zài jiā lǐ le wǒ shén me dōu méi mǎi
items.en: I left my wallet at home, so I bought nothing.
items.why: 什么 + 都 + 没 means 'nothing at all'. 还 would turn it into 'haven't bought anything yet'.

items.q: 你想买哪个颜色？我哪个___可以，你选吧。
items.zh: 你想买哪个颜色？我哪个都可以，你选吧。
items.py: nǐ xiǎng mǎi nǎ ge yán sè wǒ nǎ ge dōu kě yǐ nǐ xuǎn ba
items.en: Which colour do you want to buy? Any one is fine with me; you choose.
items.why: 哪个 + 都 + 可以 means 'any is fine'. The question word precedes 都 and 才/又 cannot take this meaning.

items.q: 他对运动很感兴趣，什么运动他___愿意试一试。
items.zh: 他对运动很感兴趣，什么运动他都愿意试一试。
items.py: tā duì yùn dòng hěn gǎn xìng qù shén me yùn dòng tā dōu yuàn yì shì yī shì
items.en: He loves sport and is willing to try any sport.
items.why: 什么运动 is fronted and totalled by 都, giving 'any sport at all'. 才 'only then' and 又 'again' do not express 'willing to try any'.

items.q: 他一分钱___没带，所以不能买东西。
items.zh: 他一分钱也没带，所以不能买东西。
items.py: tā yī fēn qián yě méi dài suǒ yǐ bù néng mǎi dōng xi
items.en: He didn't bring a single cent, so he can't buy anything.
items.why: 'Not a single cent' is 一分钱 + 也 + 没. 才 and 就 do not give 'not even one'.

items.q: 那家店的衣服，我一件___没买。
items.zh: 那家店的衣服，我一件都没买。
items.py: nà jiā diàn de yī fu wǒ yī jiàn dōu méi mǎi
items.en: I didn't buy a single item from that shop.
items.why: 一 + measure + 都/也 + 没 means 'not even one'. 就 and 才 do not fit before 没 in this meaning.

items.q: 这个价格对我来说一点儿也___贵。
items.zh: 这个价格对我来说一点儿也不贵。
items.py: zhè ge jià gé duì wǒ lái shuō yī diǎn r yě bù guì
items.en: This price is not expensive at all to me.
items.why: 'Not at all' needs a negative after 一点儿也. 太 and 很 would turn it into a positive and make the sentence ungrammatical.

items.q: ___十点了，你怎么还不起床？
items.zh: 都十点了，你怎么还不起床？
items.py: dōu shí diǎn le nǐ zěn me hái bù qǐ chuáng
items.en: It's already ten o'clock. Why aren't you up yet?
items.why: 都 + time + 了 means 'already', with a complaining tone that fits 怎么还不. 才 would mean 'only ten', the opposite.

items.q: 你看，我们___等了两个小时了，他怎么还没来？
items.zh: 你看，我们都等了两个小时了，他怎么还没来？
items.py: nǐ kàn wǒ men dōu děng le liǎng gè xiǎo shí le tā zěn me hái méi lái
items.en: Look, we've already waited two hours; why hasn't he come?
items.why: 都 ... 了 marks 'already so long', matching the complaint. 才 would mean 'only two hours', which does not fit 怎么还没来.

items.q: 他___三十岁了，还不想买房子。
items.zh: 他都三十岁了，还不想买房子。
items.py: tā dōu sān shí suì le hái bù xiǎng mǎi fáng zi
items.en: He is already thirty and still doesn't want to buy a house.
items.why: 都 + age + 了 means 'already that old'; 还不想 shows the speaker's surprise. 才 would say 'only thirty' and drop 了.

items.q: 这个手机___用了五年了，该换新的了。
items.zh: 这个手机都用了五年了，该换新的了。
items.py: zhè ge shǒu jī dōu yòng le wǔ nián le gāi huàn xīn de le
items.en: This phone has already been used for five years; it's time for a new one.
items.why: 都 ... 了 stresses a long time, which supports 该换新的了. 才 would say 'only five years' and not support replacing it.

items.q: ___快半夜了，商店早就关门了，你明天再去买吧。
items.zh: 都快半夜了，商店早就关门了，你明天再去买吧。
items.py: dōu kuài bàn yè le shāng diàn zǎo jiù guān mén le nǐ míng tiān zài qù mǎi ba
items.en: It's almost midnight already; the shops closed long ago, so go and buy it tomorrow.
items.why: 都快...了 means 'already almost'. 才 would say it is still early, which clashes with the shops being closed; 又 'again' has no sense here.

items.zh: 孩子们都想学游泳。
items.py: hái zi men dōu xiǎng xué yóu yǒng
items.en: The children all want to learn to swim.
items.why: 都 follows the plural subject and comes before the modal 想. It cannot come after 想 or at the end.

items.zh: 这些鞋都很便宜。
items.py: zhè xiē xié dōu hěn pián yi
items.en: All of these shoes are cheap.
items.why: 都 totals 这些鞋 and goes before 很. 很都便宜 puts it after the degree word and is wrong.

items.zh: 我们都想买新鞋。
items.py: wǒ men dōu xiǎng mǎi xīn xié
items.en: We all want to buy new shoes.
items.why: 都 follows 我们 and precedes the modal 想. 我们想都买新鞋 is wrong.

items.zh: 我的同学都喜欢打乒乓球。
items.py: wǒ de tóng xué dōu xǐ huan dǎ pīng pāng qiú
items.en: My classmates all like playing table tennis.
items.why: 都 follows 我的同学 and precedes 喜欢. It cannot follow the verb.

items.zh: 我们都打算去体育馆打篮球。
items.py: wǒ men dōu dǎ suàn qù tǐ yù guǎn dǎ lán qiú
items.en: We all plan to go to the sports hall to play basketball.
items.why: 都 totals 我们 and goes before 打算 and everything after it. 打算都去 would split the predicate wrongly.

items.zh: 这些苹果我都买了。
items.py: zhè xiē píng guǒ wǒ dōu mǎi le
items.en: I bought all of these apples.
items.why: 都 can only total something to its left, so 这些苹果 stands before 都. 我都买了这些苹果 leaves 都 nothing to total.

items.zh: 这两双球鞋我都很喜欢。
items.py: zhè liǎng shuāng qiú xié wǒ dōu hěn xǐ huan
items.en: I like both of these pairs of sneakers.
items.why: The two pairs must stand left of 都 to be totalled. 我都很喜欢这两双球鞋 gives 都 only a single 我.

items.zh: 比赛的票我们都卖完了。
items.py: bǐ sài de piào wǒ men dōu mài wán le
items.en: We have sold all the tickets for the match.
items.why: The tickets are fronted so 都 can total them: 都 sits before the verb 卖完了.

items.zh: 那几件打折的衣服妈妈都给姐姐买了。
items.py: nà jǐ jiàn dǎ zhé de yī fu mā ma dōu gěi jiě jie mǎi le
items.en: Mum bought all those discounted clothes for my older sister.
items.why: 都 totals the fronted clothes and stands before the 给 phrase. 给姐姐都买了 would put 都 after the coverb phrase.

items.zh: 我也喜欢打网球。
items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan dǎ wǎng qiú
items.en: I like playing tennis too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject and precedes the verb 喜欢. 我喜欢也打网球 puts it after the verb.

items.zh: 我弟弟也想学游泳。
items.py: wǒ dì di yě xiǎng xué yóu yǒng
items.en: My younger brother wants to learn to swim too.
items.why: 也 comes after the subject, before the modal 想. 我弟弟想也学游泳 puts it in the wrong place.

items.zh: 这家店的鞋也很贵。
items.py: zhè jiā diàn de xié yě hěn guì
items.en: The shoes in this shop are expensive too.
items.why: 也 goes before 很 and the adjective. It cannot go after 贵 like English 'too'.

items.zh: 我妹妹也想参加这次游泳比赛。
items.py: wǒ mèi mei yě xiǎng cān jiā zhè cì yóu yǒng bǐ sài
items.en: My younger sister wants to take part in this swimming competition too.
items.why: 也 sits between the subject 我妹妹 and the modal 想, not after 想 or at the end.

items.zh: 他们也都买了新球拍。
items.py: tā men yě dōu mǎi le xīn qiú pāi
items.en: They all bought new rackets too.
items.why: 也 and 都 are both needed and 也 comes first. 都也 is not possible.

items.zh: 这些衣服我也都试过了。
items.py: zhè xiē yī fu wǒ yě dōu shì guo le
items.en: I have tried on all of these clothes too.
items.why: The clothes are fronted so 都 can total them, and 也 precedes 都. 都也 is wrong.

items.zh: 他们都没买球票。
items.py: tā men dōu méi mǎi qiú piào
items.en: None of them bought tickets.
items.why: 都 comes before 没 and means none. 没都买 is not possible.

items.zh: 我们不都喜欢踢足球。
items.py: wǒ men bù dōu xǐ huan tī zú qiú
items.en: Not all of us like playing football.
items.why: 不 before 都 means 'not all'. 都不喜欢 would say none of us like it.

items.zh: 我们也都不打算买贵的手机。
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù dǎ suàn mǎi guì de shǒu jī
items.en: None of us plans to buy expensive phones either.
items.why: 也 then 都 then 不: 也都不. 'None' needs 都 before 不, and 'either' needs 也 before 都.

items.zh: 我每天都跑步。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān dōu pǎo bù
items.en: I run every day.
items.why: 每天 is followed by 都 before the verb. 都每天 and 我每天跑步都 are both wrong.

items.zh: 每个人都要买票。
items.py: měi gè rén dōu yào mǎi piào
items.en: Everyone has to buy a ticket.
items.why: 都 follows 每个人 and precedes 要. It does not go at the end.

items.zh: 他每次买东西都讨价还价。
items.py: tā měi cì mǎi dōng xi dōu tǎo jià huán jià
items.en: He bargains every time he shops.
items.why: After 每次 ... comes 都 before the verb. 都 cannot come before 每次.

items.zh: 谁都喜欢这家店。
items.py: shéi dōu xǐ huan zhè jiā diàn
items.en: Everyone likes this shop.
items.why: 谁 is followed by 都 before the verb. 谁喜欢都 puts 都 after the verb.

items.zh: 我什么都不想买。
items.py: wǒ shén me dōu bù xiǎng mǎi
items.en: I don't want to buy anything.
items.why: The question word 什么 stands before 都 even as the object, then 不 follows. 我不想买什么都 is wrong.

items.zh: 他什么运动都不喜欢。
items.py: tā shén me yùn dòng dōu bù xǐ huan
items.en: He doesn't like any sport.
items.why: 什么运动 sits before 都 and 不, meaning 'no sport at all'. Leaving 什么运动 after the verb (他不喜欢什么运动) does not give the 'any sport' sense and needs 都/也 to fix.

items.zh: 他什么时候都可以陪你去买衣服。
items.py: tā shén me shí hou dōu kě yǐ péi nǐ qù mǎi yī fu
items.en: He can go clothes shopping with you at any time.
items.why: 什么时候 + 都 = 'at any time', placed before the modal 可以. 都 cannot follow 可以.

items.zh: 这件衣服一点儿都不贵。
items.py: zhè jiàn yī fu yī diǎn r dōu bù guì
items.en: This garment is not expensive at all.
items.why: The fixed order is 一点儿, then 都/也, then 不, then the adjective. 不一点儿贵 is wrong.

items.zh: 他一分钱也没花。
items.py: tā yī fēn qián yě méi huā
items.en: He didn't spend a single cent.
items.why: 'Not a single cent' is 一分钱 + 也 + 没 before the verb. Without 没 the sentence would be affirmative and wrong.

items.zh: 都十一点了他还没起床。
items.py: dōu shí yī diǎn le tā hái méi qǐ chuáng
items.en: It's already eleven and he still isn't up.
items.why: 都 + time + 了 means 'already'. 了 must stay at the end of the time phrase.

items.zh: 这双鞋都穿了五年了。
items.py: zhè shuāng xié dōu chuān le wǔ nián le
items.en: I've already worn these shoes for five years.
items.why: 都 comes before the verb phrase with the time amount, and the final 了 closes the 'already' meaning. Without 了 it would sound unfinished.

items.src_py: wǒ mǎi le zhè xiē yī fu
items.task: Say you bought ALL of them: put 这些衣服 first and add 都.
items.zh: 这些衣服我都买了。
items.py: zhè xiē yī fu wǒ dōu mǎi le
items.en: I bought all of these clothes.
items.why: 都 can only total what stands to its left, so the object moves in front of 都. Leaving it after the verb gives 都 nothing to total.

items.src_py: tā men dōu xǐ huan zhè ge pái zi
items.task: Say that not all of them like it.
items.zh: 他们不都喜欢这个牌子。
items.py: tā men bù dōu xǐ huan zhè ge pái zi
items.en: Not all of them like this brand.
items.why: 不 before 都 means 'not all'. 都不喜欢 would mean none of them like it.

items.src_py: wǒ men dōu qù kàn zú qiú bǐ sài
items.zh: 我们也都去看足球比赛。
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu qù kàn zú qiú bǐ sài
items.en: We are all going to watch the football match too.
items.why: 也 is added before 都: 也都. The reverse order 都也 is not possible.

items.src_py: zhè ge qiú pāi hěn zhòng
items.task: Say it is not heavy at all (use 一点儿).
items.zh: 这个球拍一点儿都不重。
items.py: zhè ge qiú pāi yī diǎn r dōu bù zhòng
items.en: This racket is not heavy at all.
items.why: 'Not at all' is 一点儿 + 都/也 + 不 + adjective, and 很 is dropped. 不一点儿重 is wrong.

items.task: Say he does it every weekend (use 每个周末 and 都).
items.zh: 弟弟每个周末都踢足球。
items.py: dì di měi gè zhōu mò dōu tī zú qiú
items.en: My younger brother plays football every weekend.
items.why: 每个周末 is followed by 都 before the verb. 都 cannot come before 每个周末 or after 踢足球.

items.s_py: wǒ men qù dōu chāo shì mǎi dōng xi
items.zh: 我们都去超市买东西。
items.py: wǒ men dōu qù chāo shì mǎi dōng xi
items.en: We are all going to the supermarket to buy things.
items.why: 都 must stand before the verb 去, after the subject it totals. After the verb it is impossible.

items.s_py: wǒ men dōu zài wǎng shàng mǎi qiú xié
items.zh: 我们都在网上买球鞋。
items.py: wǒ men dōu zài wǎng shàng mǎi qiú xié
items.en: We all buy sneakers online.
items.why: Correct: 都 comes before the 在 phrase, not after it, and follows the plural subject 我们.

items.s_py: zhè xiē qiú wǒ mǎi le dōu
items.zh: 这些球我都买了。
items.py: zhè xiē qiú wǒ dōu mǎi le
items.en: I bought all of these balls.
items.why: 都 cannot end the sentence. It stands right after what it totals (这些球 and 我) and before the verb.

items.s: 这些票我们都没买到，只好看电视了。
items.s_py: zhè xiē piào wǒ men dōu méi mǎi dào zhǐ hǎo kàn diàn shì le
items.zh: 这些票我们都没买到，只好看电视了。
items.py: zhè xiē piào wǒ men dōu méi mǎi dào zhǐ hǎo kàn diàn shì le
items.en: We couldn't buy any of these tickets, so we had to watch on TV.
items.why: Correct: the fronted 这些票 is totalled by 都 and 没 follows 都. 都没 means none of the tickets.

items.s_py: yě wǒ xiǎng xué dǎ tài jí quán
items.zh: 我也想学打太极拳。
items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng xué dǎ tài jí quán
items.en: I want to learn tai chi too.
items.why: 也 cannot come before the subject like 'Also,'. It follows the subject and precedes the modal 想.

items.s_py: nǐ qù yóu yǒng wǒ yě qù
items.zh: 你去游泳，我也去。
items.py: nǐ qù yóu yǒng wǒ yě qù
items.en: You are going swimming; I'll go too.
items.why: Correct: 也 sits after 我 and before the verb 去, as in 'I too go'. It cannot come at the end or before 我.

items.s_py: xiǎo wáng mǎi yě le yī shuāng qiú xié
items.zh: 小王也买了一双球鞋。
items.py: xiǎo wáng yě mǎi le yī shuāng qiú xié
items.en: Xiao Wang bought a pair of sneakers too.
items.why: 也 goes before the verb 买, not between the verb and 了.

items.s_py: tā men dōu yě xǐ huan kàn zú qiú
items.zh: 他们也都喜欢看足球。
items.py: tā men yě dōu xǐ huan kàn zú qiú
items.en: They all like watching football too.
items.why: The order is always 也都. 都也 does not exist.

items.s: 这些球鞋我也都试过，但是都不太合适。
items.s_py: zhè xiē qiú xié wǒ yě dōu shì guo dàn shì dōu bù tài hé shì
items.zh: 这些球鞋我也都试过，但是都不太合适。
items.py: zhè xiē qiú xié wǒ yě dōu shì guo dàn shì dōu bù tài hé shì
items.en: I've tried on all of these sneakers too, but none of them fit very well.
items.why: Correct: 也都 (in that order) after the fronted object, and 都不 in the second clause means none.

items.s_py: wǒ bù yě xiǎng qù nà jiā diàn
items.zh: 我也不想去那家店。
items.py: wǒ yě bù xiǎng qù nà jiā diàn
items.en: I don't want to go to that shop either.
items.why: 也 comes before 不 in 'not ... either'. 不也 is wrong in a plain statement.

items.s: 他们不都喜欢跑步，有的人更喜欢游泳。
items.s_py: tā men bù dōu xǐ huan pǎo bù yǒu de rén gèng xǐ huan yóu yǒng
items.zh: 他们不都喜欢跑步，有的人更喜欢游泳。
items.py: tā men bù dōu xǐ huan pǎo bù yǒu de rén gèng xǐ huan yóu yǒng
items.en: Not all of them like running; some prefer swimming.
items.why: Correct: 不都 means 'not all', which fits the second clause about those who prefer swimming. 都不 would say that none like running.

items.s: 这些球鞋都不是红色的，有两双是红色的。
items.s_py: zhè xiē qiú xié dōu bù shì hóng sè de yǒu liǎng shuāng shì hóng sè de
items.zh: 这些球鞋不都是红色的，有两双是红色的。
items.py: zhè xiē qiú xié bù dōu shì hóng sè de yǒu liǎng shuāng shì hóng sè de
items.en: Not all of these sneakers are red; two pairs are red.
items.why: 都不是 means none are red, which contradicts 'two pairs are red'. 'Not all' needs 不都.

items.s_py: wǒ men yě dōu méi dài qián
items.zh: 我们也都没带钱。
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu méi dài qián
items.en: None of us brought money either.
items.why: Correct: 也 then 都, both before 没. 'None ... either' is 也都没.

items.s_py: tā měi gè zhōu mò tī dōu zú qiú
items.zh: 他每个周末都踢足球。
items.py: tā měi gè zhōu mò dōu tī zú qiú
items.en: He plays football every weekend.
items.why: 都 goes before the verb, never between the verb and its object.

items.s: 每个星期六我们都去公园打羽毛球。
items.s_py: měi gè xīng qī liù wǒ men dōu qù gōng yuán dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.zh: 每个星期六我们都去公园打羽毛球。
items.py: měi gè xīng qī liù wǒ men dōu qù gōng yuán dǎ yǔ máo qiú
items.en: Every Saturday we go to the park to play badminton.
items.why: Correct: after the 每 phrase and the subject, 都 comes before the verb 去.

items.s: 他什么也没买，只是看了看。
items.s_py: tā shén me yě méi mǎi zhǐ shì kàn le kan
items.zh: 他什么也没买，只是看了看。
items.py: tā shén me yě méi mǎi zhǐ shì kàn le kan
items.en: He didn't buy anything; he just looked.
items.why: Correct: in a negative sentence 也 works like 都 after 什么. 什么也没买 means nothing at all.

items.s_py: zhè ge bāo yī diǎn r yě guì
items.zh: 这个包一点儿也不贵。
items.py: zhè ge bāo yī diǎn r yě bù guì
items.en: This bag isn't expensive at all.
items.why: 一点儿也 only works with a negative. 不 is required before 贵.

items.s: 都快十点了，商店怎么还没开门？
items.s_py: dōu kuài shí diǎn le shāng diàn zěn me hái méi kāi mén
items.zh: 都快十点了，商店怎么还没开门？
items.py: dōu kuài shí diǎn le shāng diàn zěn me hái méi kāi mén
items.en: It's almost ten already; why hasn't the shop opened yet?
items.why: Correct: 都 ... 了 means 'already', here with 快 and a complaint. It does not mean 'all'.
